ask: rule
company: camunda
title: Post Sales Engineer - North America
options: Wilmington [undeclared]
description:
Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform.
[under: What you'll be doing] - Provide consulting services to customers including process modeling, process automation with Camunda platform, software engineering and architecture on-site and remotely.
[under: LI-DNI] If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.
[under: Benefits & Perks] We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based.
[under: Benefits & Perks] Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.
[under: Benefits & Perks] - Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.
[under: Benefits & Perks] - Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.
[under: Benefits & Perks] Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!
